body:
## What to build

Allow unsorted local expansion to omit a factor-valued matrix or higher-dimensional array with a supported typed-missing Margin label while preserving its shape and factor components. Validation must not recurse through an upstream missingness method that cannot handle this shape when ordinary missing-value construction and branch combination already succeed.

On main `4c63bb917ed7ed31ff6aadf060a5eae7a32cd004`, construct a factor containing `a`, give it dimensions one by one, and put it in one tibble column. An included-only Grouping specification succeeds. An unsorted rollup with a NULL Margin label fails with expressionStackOverflowError and 'evaluation nested too deeply: infinite recursion / options(expressions=)?'. Ordinary mutation using a one-row vec_init value followed by union_all succeeds, yielding a two-by-one factor matrix containing the original value and a typed missing value.

The public Margin-label reference explicitly admits local matrix/array dimensions with NULL or NA_character_ labels and promises omitted shape and typed missing components. The representability check calls vec_detect_missing on the factor-array prototype and triggers recursion before expansion branches are built. A corresponding shaped integer dimension succeeds. Ordinary factor-array grouping and sorting also encounter upstream recursion; this ticket concerns the independently supported unsorted row-copy boundary, not general repairs to dplyr/vctrs grouping, sorting, or arbitrary class attributes.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The minimal one-by-one factor-matrix rollup with NULL label and no Margin order returns the same values, dimensions, factor levels, and missing component as the successful ordinary mutation/union control.
- [ ] Cover populated/empty factor matrices and higher-dimensional factor arrays with NULL and valid NA_character_ labels, plus included-only and shaped-integer controls.
- [ ] Preserve the separate refusal for an unrepresentable missing value, non-missing array labels, and an NA_character_ label conflicting with a declared factor NA level; NULL retains its established NA-level meaning.
- [ ] Do not add an arbitrary attribute-restoration guarantee or hide independent upstream grouping/sorting conditions under ADR 0016.

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately).

## Investigation evidence

[The dated investigation](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/0ca171fdb1d231f068f95d4b6aea53794ca3cb77/investigation/expand-grouping-systematic-hunt-2026-10-29.md) records the pinned baseline, ranked hypotheses, discriminating controls, independent reproductions, bounded matrix results, and limitations. [The focused replay](https://github.com/sayuks/marginplyr/blob/0ca171fdb1d231f068f95d4b6aea53794ca3cb77/investigation/2026-10-29-expand-grouping-systematic-hunt/local/factor-array-reproduce.R) and retained replay logs are published in PR #1053. Its `--assert` mode intentionally exits 1 on the investigated baseline; no implementation repair is included.

title: [P2] Validate typed missing factor-array dimensions without recursive failure
